newsitem.title: UK: Gold fixes below key $380 support level.
newsitem.headline: Gold fixes below key $380 support level.

text.p: Gold fixed below the psychological $380 support level on Monday for the first time in over a year, posting a fresh low since September 6, 1995.
It fixed at $379.30 an ounce, compared to $380.70 on Friday afternoon and $380.40 in the morning.
Gold fixes below key $380 support level =2
Gold has been under pressure over the past three weeks from selling by investment funds, and interest from investors has been lacklustre due to healthy U.S. stock and bond markets.
Dealers said gold's failure to rebound on Friday after briefly dipping below the $380 level raised the prospect that prices could go still lower.
"There's a general concern in Europe that it's not over yet," a dealer said.
Below $380, the $379 level is expected to provide some support for gold. Analysts said a breach of that level likely meant weakness would spill over into the other precious metals.
